create_custom_op_class: create a custom op class inheriting from CustomOp with backend-specific forward methods
build_backend_dispatch: build a custom op that dispatches to cuda, hip, musa, or native implementations based on platform
test_forward_native: test the forward_native fallback implementation of a CustomOp subclass
implement_forward_cuda: implement the forward_cuda method for a CustomOp subclass targeting GPU execution
register_custom_op: register a CustomOp subclass using the @CustomOp.register decorator with a unique name
